screens.name: 01-discovery
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE standalone mobile wireframe reference image, portrait 1024x1536, for the existing Shortlet Concierge web application. Cross-platform neutral phone, subtle thin dark device outline centered, white outer background, no perspective, no decorative objects. A readable frontend handoff drawing, medium fidelity flat wireframe, no photos or image placeholders because existing A2UI surfaces are text-based. Consistent design: warm white #f5f5f0, white surfaces, charcoal text #1c2520, grey rules #d8d8cf, restrained dark green #0c6b4f only for primary controls. Clean system sans, comfortably readable body at equivalent 16px, 20px headings, minimum 44px tap controls, 16px padding, restrained 12px corners. One active workspace only. Header always 'Shortlet Concierge'. Bottom sticky composer with 'Message the concierge' and 'Send', above safe area. No bottom tabs, no My stays tab, no map, no favorites, no voice, no ratings, no invented app menus, no card data fields, no instant booking. A small caption OUTSIDE the phone at top gives screen number and title, at bottom 'Layout reference • Illustrative data'. Draw current shell model: short conversation above one bordered workspace; focused screens use most vertical space but remain within the conversation shell, with a 'Close' control in workspace header. User content below is exact where quoted. Don't add controls beyond specified ones. No developer terminology within product UI.
01 / Discovery. Short user bubble 'Lekki, 18–21 September, 2 guests.' Assistant bubble '2 eligible units found.' Active inline workspace title 'Discovery results'. Caption 'Stay: 18–21 Sep 2026'. A horizontally browsable row showing ONE full unit card and a thin glimpse of the next card, no photos. Full card: 'Lekki Apartment A'; 'Lekki Phase 1, Lagos'; 'Capacity: 2 guests'; 'Amenities: Wi-Fi, backup power'. Distinct stacked amounts 'All-In Stay Total' '₦240,000' and 'Refundable Security Deposit' '₦0'. 'Inspection: passed'; 'Inspected: 1 Aug 2026'; 'Current through: 1 Aug 2027'. Button 'View Unit'. Beneath row button 'See all results'. Fine disclosure 'Open dates require operator confirmation.' Outside-phone small annotation 'Existing inline surface / text-based Basic Catalog'.
screens.edit: Remove only the Close control from the Discovery results header; this inline workspace does not have a Close action. Preserve every other text, number, layout, device frame, colors and annotation exactly.
